entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: This is a fail-closed registration invariant, not a rejection of an admitted query shape. lowerWithMixedOperandPolicy is invoked inside existing matched root/operand branches with explicit family/site constants; requireMixedPlanPolicy is invoked by existing mixed consumers with their real family. Every current pair is registered as bespoke in mixedOperandPolicies. The scalar/vector binary and aggregate family classifiers cover the operators their parser-checked dispatches can pass; their empty fallback represents an invalid internal operator, not a parseable route. Missing registrations and non-bespoke modes are exercised with synthetic calls or temporary table mutation in the authority tests. The production table has no external configuration or query-controlled entries, and ordinary float/histogram-only plans bypass this mixed-only check. A future caller or payload-mode migration must update this claim rather than silently treat a new wire rejection as internal.
